headline: Sales and profit grow strongly from a year ago
summary_short: Tata Power revenue was ₹19,636 crore, up 26.3% y/y and 3.1% q/q, with net income of ₹1,366 crore, up 48.6% y/y.
summary_long: EBITDA was ₹4,851 crore, up 16.6% y/y and 8.0% q/q. Q2 operating updates from the company's renewables arm cited 419 MW of utility-scale projects commissioned. Prior-quarter revenue and profit on the shard match Tata Power's reported Q1 FY27 figures.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Shard values are in INR millions converted to crore here. Fiscal year ends in March; the shard's Q3 label corresponds to fiscal Q2 FY27 (July-September 2026).
